description: Java class 'ImageUtils' providing utility methods for processing images, including SVG and raster images, generating thumbnails, converting media types, and extracting metadata.

classes.name: ProcessedImage
classes.description: Data class representing an image with media type, dimensions, data, size, and optional preview.

classes.name: ScadaSymbolMetadataInfo
classes.description: Class encapsulating metadata information extracted from SVG or other symbol files, including title, description, tags, and widget size.

methods.name: mediaTypeToFileExtension
methods.description: Converts MIME media type to file extension.

methods.name: fileExtensionToMediaType
methods.description: Converts file extension to MIME media type.

methods.name: processImage
methods.description: Processes image data, generating a thumbnail and handling SVG and raster images.

methods.name: processSvgImage
methods.description: Processes SVG image data, generating a PNG thumbnail.

methods.name: toCompressedPngData
methods.description: Converts a BufferedImage to compressed PNG byte array.

methods.name: previewAsOriginalImage
methods.description: Creates a ProcessedImage object with original data, used when thumbnail generation fails.

methods.name: withPreviewAsOriginalImage
methods.description: Associates a preview image with the original image.

methods.name: processScadaSymbolMetadata
methods.description: Extracts metadata from SVG or symbol files.

methods.name: removeScadaSymbolMetadata
methods.description: Removes metadata tags from SVG content.

methods.name: getThumbnailDimensions
methods.description: Calculates thumbnail dimensions maintaining aspect ratio within max size.

methods.name: getEmbeddedBase64EncodedImg
methods.description: Generates a base64-encoded PNG data URI for a given color string.

methods.name: parseColor
methods.description: Parses color string in hex, rgb, or hsla format into a Color object.

methods.name: parseRgbColor
methods.description: Parses rgb color string into Color.

methods.name: parseHslaColor
methods.description: Parses hsla color string into Color.

methods.name: hslaToColor
methods.description: Converts HSLA color values to a Color object.
